name: remotion-factory
description: Turn articles, scripts, brief notes, science explainers, informational content, or code projects into MP4 videos using Remotion. Includes content type detection, Feynman-style script expansion for long-form narration, director aesthetics with cinematic scene composition, audio-first workflow, creative scene planning, style adaptation, static scene linting, reference images support, Agent Teams quality checks, and comprehensive design system with light/dark rhythm.

notes.core: All workflow phases, TTS synthesis, scene development, rendering pipeline are platform-independent.
notes.claude-code-only: Dual-agent parallel quality checks and Agent Teams parallel chapter development require Claude Code's agent tooling.
